useRateLimiting.description:
Limit the requests per client IP on the endpoints that work without a login
(login, register, health check for updates, geo lookup, search suggest).
Turn off when a reverse proxy already does this.
use env variable: app__UseRateLimiting
Can be switched at runtime when the limiter was enabled at startup (end-to-end tests)

trustedProxies.description:
IP addresses or CIDR networks (e.g. "172.17.0.1" or "10.0.0.0/8") of reverse proxies
that are trusted to set the X-Forwarded-For / X-Forwarded-Proto headers.
Leave empty (the default) to trust only loopback, which is enough when the reverse
proxy connects to this app over localhost (e.g. NgInx on the same host).
Only set this when the proxy connects from a different host/container (e.g. Docker),
and only to that proxy's own address — do NOT use this to "trust everyone", that lets
any client spoof their IP and bypass the login/register rate limiter and the
NoAccountLocalhost auto-login check.
use env variable: app__TrustedProxies__0, app__TrustedProxies__1, ...

trustedProxiesCloudflare.description:
Add Cloudflare's published edge IP ranges to TrustedProxies automatically (see
CloudflareTrustedProxiesHelper for the list), instead of pasting them into
TrustedProxies by hand. Only enable this when Cloudflare is actually in front of this
app, and the origin is not otherwise reachable directly (firewall it to Cloudflare's
IPs, use Cloudflare Tunnel, or Authenticated Origin Pulls) — trusting the header is not
a substitute for that.
use env variable: app__TrustedProxiesCloudflare

second.description: Custom offset: Seconds to add/subtract (can be negative)

hasAnyOffset.description: Check if at least one offset value is provided

ExifCustomOffsetCorrectionRequest.description:
Request model for custom offset EXIF correction
Uses custom time/date offsets (years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds)

ExifStatus.description: Used to display file status (eg. NotFoundNotInIndex, Ok)

recordedTimezoneId.description:
The timezone the camera thought it was in (source offset)
IANA timezone ID (e.g., "Europe/Amsterdam", "America/New_York")

correctTimezoneId.description:
The actual timezone where the photo was taken (target offset)
IANA timezone ID (e.g., "Europe/Amsterdam", "America/New_York")

ExifTimezoneBasedCorrectionRequest.description:
Request model for timezone-based EXIF correction
Uses IANA timezone IDs to calculate offset differences (DST-aware)

filePath.description:
Get a concatenated subPath style filepath to find the location
The file path.

fileName.description:
Get or Set FileName with extension
Without first slash or path
The name of the file with extension

fileHash.description:
Base32 hash to identify this file. Gets or sets the file hash.
The file hash.

fileCollectionName.description:
GetFileNameWithoutExtension (only a getter)
The name of the file collection.

parentDirectory.description:
Get/Set Relative path of the parent Directory
The parent directory in subPath style

isDirectory.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is directory.
`true` if this instance is directory; otherwise (then is a file), `false`.

tags.description:
Get/Set a comma separated string of unique tags.
Duplicate keywords are case sensitive removed
The tags.

description.description:
Gets or sets the iptc:Caption-Abstract or xmp:description.
The description as string

title.description:
Gets or sets the iptc:Object Name or xmp:title.
The title as string

dateTime.description:
Date/Time Digitized or Date/Time Original
Assumes localTime
The DateTime object

addToDatabase.description:
Datetime of when this item is added to the database
The add to database DateTime value

lastEdited.description:
Datetime of the last change to this object
The last edited DateTime value

latitude.description:
Latitude as decimal degrees using WGS84 (stored as double)
The latitude value

longitude.description:
Longitude  as decimal degrees using WGS84 (stored as double)
The longitude value

locationAltitude.description:
Location altitude in meters. How how difference there is relative to WGS84 round earth.
(This might be different than meters above sea level)
The location altitude.

locationCity.description:
The name of the nearest city
The location city.

locationState.description:
The name of the nearest state or province (Max length is 40 chars)
The state of the location.

locationCountry.description:
The name of the nearest country (Max length is 40 chars)
The location country.

locationCountryCode.description:
ISO-3166-1 alpha-3 (for example NLD for The Netherlands)
@see: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3

imageWidth.description:
Gets or sets the width of the image. (saved as ushort 0-65535)
Side effect: when rotating; this may not be updated
The width of the image.

imageHeight.description:
Gets or sets the height of the image. (saved as ushort 0-65535)
Side effect: when rotating; this may not be updated
The height of the image.

collectionPaths.description:
To show location of files with the same Filename without extension
The collection paths, relative to the database (subPath style)

aperture.description:
Gets or sets the aperture. (round to 5 decimals)
The aperture.

shutterSpeed.description:
Shutter speed as string so '1/2' or '1'
The shutter speed as string

isoSpeed.description:
Gets or sets the iso speed used by cameras  (saved as ushort 0-65535)
The iso speed.

makeModel.description:
Camera Make, Model and Lens (saved pipe separated string)
Camera brand and type (incl. lens)

make.description: Get the Make (Camera Brand) of the _makeModel

model.description: Get the Model (Camera Model) of the _makeModel

focalLength.description: The Zoom of the camera (that is currently used)

size.description: Size of the file in bytes (BigInt)

lastChanged.description: Fields that are changed in the last request

suggestedTags.description:
AI generated tags that should be suggested to the user.
Stored as comma separated string.

rejectedTags.description:
AI generated tags rejected by the user.
Stored as comma separated string.

imageClassificationModel.description: Name/version of the model that generated AI metadata.

imageClassificationGeneratedAt.description: Datetime when AI metadata was generated.

detectedPatternDescription.description: Detected datetime pattern in filename (e.g., YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS)

targetFilePath.description: Target file path with corrected datetime in filename

hasError.description: Indicates if there was an error

errorMessage.description: Error message if HasError is true

FTP URL including credentials.

FileHash before importing

dateTimeFromFileName.description: Is the Exif DateTime parsed from the fileName

origin.description: Where the file is imported from

true is to copy all files in the list
false is to respect the Copy flag in PublishProfile

serviceName.description: Which container is the logging stored

logsHeader.description:
The header for the logs endpoint
use apikey=value for the header name apikey

enabled.description: Enable or disable this optimizer by default for new publish profiles.

quality.description:
Quality level for image optimization (0-100).
Higher values result in better quality but larger file sizes.

RelativeObjects.description: In DetailView there are values added for handling Args

Search Options eg >, <, =. (greater than sign, less than sign, equal sign)

elapsedSeconds.description: Know in seconds how much time a database query is. Rounded by 3 decimals

offset.description:

dsn.description:
Public ingest key, normally baked into Release builds.
Use this to overwrite it (app__Sentry__Dsn)
